parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 6 and expanding TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' dropped val_bpb from 1.017 to 0.869. The additional data and increased capacity seem to be working well together. Moving on to hyperparameter tuning for the next stage.
parsed.description: Slightly decrease learning rate and introduce weight decay to improve generalization and prevent overfitting following the large scale-up.
